title: Ranking synergy follow-up
decision: Keep several modest signals for prospective study; no serving scorer change is supported.

metric_contract.balanced_auc: unweighted mean of high and low AUC
metric_contract.tails: top-20 high and bottom-20 low, reported separately

history_signal_grid.formula: z(current) + 0.25 * z(signal); means/scales fit on the 966 training rows
history_signal_grid.interpretation: Small validation gain, slightly weaker later AUC; author/day intervals include zero. Recency and cluster+recency were not validation winners.

current_ranker_factorial.design: Fixed 2^3 factorial: stronger author weighting, ESS5 kernel shrinkage, and similarity-weighted top-five negative aggregation.
current_ranker_factorial.uncertainty: Paired whole-calendar-day intervals include zero; later period is reused exploratory evidence.

templates.labeled_metadata: Title: … Author: … Description: … Subjects: … on history and query; retrospective vector-only counterfactual.
templates.production_read_rich_history_candidate_q: Production read document on history; production candidate document on query. Read text includes title, author, cleaned description up to 4000 chars and up to 8 normalized subjects.
templates.production_read_rich_symmetric: Production read document on both history and query; rating key only selects the read branch and is not embedded.
templates.canonical_candidate_shared: Production candidate document on both history and query.

metadata_views.missing_metadata: Falls back to fresh title-author vectors.
metadata_views.availability: Enrichment was collected in September 2026; historical availability at read time is unknown.
metadata_views.standalone_primary_validation_selection: Fresh title-author selected by the two-direction gate. Production read-symmetric standalone balanced AUC was 0.585666 (high 0.560284, low 0.611047) vs 0.583675 fresh (high 0.539137, low 0.628213); the 0.017166 low-AUC decline exceeds the 0.01 allowance.
metadata_views.later_all_targets: Production read-symmetric standalone high/low AUC 0.6307/0.5214 vs 0.5980/0.5422 fresh; low-rating discrimination weakens.

fixed_score_fusion.arms: Each view fused with its matching current and ESS5 score; no weight search.
fixed_score_fusion.registration_timing: Fixed composability test registered after constituent validation and later outcomes were viewed; all fusion outcomes are descriptive.

production_read_symmetric_candidate.status: Promising candidate for a fresh prospective test; not the validation-selected fusion arm. Low-tail and temporal tradeoffs remain.

other_bounded_families.source_confidence: Rated-read rows lack source/confidence fields. ESS5 composition: 127 save/reject actions (57 saves, 70 rejects, propensity 1), latest-feedback AUC 0.4060 to 0.4041; 47 same-run impressions AUC 0.7765 to 0.7879 with only 3 saves. Selected/incomplete exposure; no causal source-confidence claim.
other_bounded_families.seed_order: Recent-first seeds improved all-book similarity, not unseen-author similarity; see five-hypothesis review.
other_bounded_families.provider_probe: Bounded probe returned zero recommendation edges.
other_bounded_families.slate: Existing bounded local swaps cover the first eight results; no live utility or full historical slate reconstruction.

parity_and_limits.embedding_repeatability: Cached/fresh execution cosine 0.9967-0.9981; score differences up to 4 points. Each view uses its matching fresh title-author control.
parity_and_limits.causal_scope: Retrospective ratings cannot establish live utility, historical candidate availability, or reader preference. Later outcomes are reused exploratory evidence.

reproduction.command: OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 uv run --project engine --extra dev python engine/scripts/evaluate_ranking_synergy.py --corpus /path/to/private-corpus.json --backend ollama --model qwen3-embedding:4b --output /path/to/private-aggregate.json

metadata_history_joint_replay.description: Fixed 0.25-SD history additions to the validation-selected older labeled metadata score; descriptive joint replay.
metadata_history_joint_replay.caveat: Both favor high-rating AUC while low-rating AUC remains below matched fresh title-author controls; interaction residuals near zero and paired block intervals cross zero. Labeled template is not production-template evidence.
